ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the stars are obliterated in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'extinguishing' of stars (Tumis) is interpreted not merely as a physical darkening but as the cessation of celestial guidance and the unraveling of the cosmic order established by God. This event signifies the end of the era of prophetic signs, preparing the universe for the final reckoning where all created structures will be rendered obsolete before the Creator. It underscores the transient nature of the material world and the absolute sovereignty of Allah in initiating the Hour.
